what: Buyer purchased an ebook about veganism on Gumroad and found it entirely generated by ChatGPT, evidenced by bullet-point-only formatting and emojis before every heading; Gumroad declined to take action.
verbatim_snippet: "Bought a book about veganism and it's entirely written by chatgpt. How do i know? It consists only of bullet-point lists and it has emojis before every heading. Gumroad won't do anything about it and..."
